## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to Yappy.

## Use Case
Describe the use case for this feature. Why would it be useful? Who would benefit from it?

## Proposed Solution
If you have a specific idea for how this feature should be implemented, describe it here.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.
